description: 한국남동발전(주)_일자별 발전소 기상 정보 현황 [electricity and power] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 한국남동발전㈜. 데이터에 포함된 풍속, 풍향, 일조시간 정보는 해당 발전소에 설치된 풍력 및 태양광 발전소의 발전량을 예측하는 데 가장 중요한 변수로 사용되며, 온도와 습도는 화력발전소의 효율과 전력. Coverage: South Korea. The portal files it under the publisher 한국남동발전㈜. Its tags are 발전소 주변, 기상, 온도 습도, 강수량 및 기압, 풍향 풍속. It offers 1 resource(s) in json. The portal shows 2025-08-28 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
